stories.title: Four Renaissance paintings stolen from Sicilian museum
new_facts: Names the specific stolen artwork: three panels from Antonello da Messina's Polittico di San Gregorio.
Italy's culture minister is cited as source confirming the theft.
Paintings were taken without triggering alarms, suggesting a professional operation.
Four Antonello da Messina Renaissance paintings stolen from Messina museum during a holiday festival, day after Parma recovery.
stories.line: Four Renaissance paintings by Antonello da Messina were stolen from a Sicilian museum; authorities are investigating.

stories.title: GOP senator calls Trump vaccine order 'stupid' while backing RFK Jr.
new_facts: Cassidy publicly criticizes Trump's vaccine executive order, denies autism-vaccine link evidence.
Trump called MMR vaccine potentially 'lethal', compared it to 'gallons' of chemicals; Cassidy calls it 'crazy, stupid'.
Cassidy denies regret over his vote to confirm RFK Jr.; RFK Jr. tied to spreading misinformation.
stories.line: Republican senator Bill Cassidy criticized Trump's vaccine executive order as stupid, while defending his confirmation vote for RFK Jr. as health secretary.
